verdict.rationale: cubic automatically reviews every new PR for logic, style and security issues. It offers Flex capacity so reviews keep running past included volume, and Ultrareview for risky changes. Its analytics track how much merged code was AI-authored and which tools wrote it. The CLI and MCP server let coding agents get their own changes reviewed, though auto-approval can also skip human review on low-risk PRs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of special handling or gating for agent-authored PRs, independent or hands-on evidence of catch rate and throughput at high volume.
